items.text: A group of Iranians living in Sweden gathered with Israelis in front of the Israeli embassy in Stockholm on Wednesday, October 7. The gathering was held in memory of the victims of the October 7 attack. Videos of the event were received by Iran International.

Hojat Karimi, CEO of Tractor, stated that Alireza Beiranvand has received 35% of his contract while other players have received about 8%. He confirmed the club's financial problems and said there is a plan to increase the payment percentage to players. Karimi also commented on Beiranvand's behavior after the match and the goal he conceded.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi stated that despite Donald Trump's mention of continuing negotiations with Tehran, it is unlikely Washington will accept the Islamic Republic's conditions. He added that mistrust between the two sides is high and an agreement is likely to be step-by-step. Additionally, developments in Yemen, sanctions, and the energy market may influence the negotiation process.

Trump stated that fake media are falsely accusing him of inviting the enemy to bomb San Diego and Los Angeles. He said he was only discussing a temporary increase in gasoline prices to prevent Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons. Trump called these accusations false and a result of fake news.

Donald Trump announced that constructive negotiations with the Islamic Republic of Iran are ongoing. He emphasized that there will be no attack on Iran before the November 3 midterm elections. He also stated that Iran will not have nuclear weapons.

Zartosht Ahmadi Ragheb, a political prisoner in Karaj Central Prison, was transferred to solitary confinement. This transfer occurred while he was on the fifth day of a hunger strike. The news was reported by HRANA news agency.

Alireza Kiani discussed the necessity of support from foreign forces aligned with Iranian national interests in episode 14 of the program "Fereydoun." This topic was raised in the context of the struggle against the Islamic Republic. He emphasized the importance of such support.
